[[Team Albany]] after winning the Star Wars CCG team championship at [[DecipherCon 2000]] (8 October 2000). Four-player team, left to right: [[Chris Terwilliger]], [[Matt Sokol]], [[Brian Terwilliger]], [[Jonny Chu]].
